description_en: Queries the details of route types by calling the GetVpcRouteEntrySummary operation
description_zh: 调用GetVpcRouteEntrySummary接口查询路由类型的明细
kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-vpc-route-entry-summary --vpc-id vpc-bp15zckdt37pq720000 --route-entry-type custom --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVpcRouteEntrySummary

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由表所属的VPC的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table to query
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:
all: all route types.
custom: custom route.
system: system route.
bgp: BGP route.
cen: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
type_vpn_bgp_internal: VPN BGP route.
ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR) route
parameters.help_zh:
路由的类型。取值：
all：表示所有路由类型。
custom：表示自定义路由。
system：表示系统路由。
bgp：表示BGP路由。
cen：表示云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）路由。
type_vpn_bgp_internal：表示VPN的BGP路由。
ECR：表示专线网关路由
parameters.name: route_entry_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the route table resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由表所属地域的ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

RouteEntrySummarys.description_en: The information about all route tables returned
RouteEntrySummarys.description_zh: 查询得到的所有路由表的信息集合

items.description_en: The information about all route tables returned
items.description_zh: 查询得到的所有路由表的信息集合

EntrySummarys.description_en: The collection of route entry counts by type in a single route table
EntrySummarys.description_zh: 单个路由表中不同类型路由条目数的集合

items.description_en: The collection of route entry counts by type in a single route table
items.description_zh: 单个路由表中不同类型路由条目数的集合

Count.description_en: The number of entries in the list

RouteEntryType.description_en:
The type of the route. Valid values:
all: all route types.
custom: custom route.
system: system route.
bgp: BGP route.
cen: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
type_vpn_bgp_internal: VPN BGP route.

The returned system routes are the system routes in the system route table
